emx_inbox_subtitle: Replies to your HOMATCH emails arrive here. Read them and answer without leaving HOMATCH.
emx_inbox_empty_body: When someone answers one of your emails, the conversation appears here.
emx_inbox_failed: The inbox could not be loaded. Please try again.
emx_thread_failed: This conversation could not be loaded.
emx_pick_conversation: Choose a conversation to read it.
emx_auth_failed: This message failed sender authentication. Be careful with links and requests in it.
emx_reply_note: Your reply is sent from your HOMATCH sender, in the same email thread.
emx_reply_failed: The reply could not be sent.
emx_err_opted_out: This person has unsubscribed. HOMATCH will not email them.
emx_err_sending_disabled: Email sending is switched off right now.
emx_err_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a little and try again.
emx_err_provider: The email provider is not available. Please try again later.
emp_subtitle: Your email allowance, how much is used, and your plan. All prices include 18% VAT.
emp_load_failed: Your plan could not be loaded.
emp_free_lifetime_note: 50 emails in total, once per account. This allowance does not renew.
emp_period: Billing cycle {{from}} – {{to}}. Unused emails expire at the end of the cycle.
emp_lapsed: Your paid plan has ended. Buy a month to continue sending.
emp_overage_used: {{n}} extra emails sent this cycle ({{blocks}} blocks of 1,000 charged)
emp_unit_note: One email = one message the provider accepted. Failed, blocked or suppressed messages are not counted.
emp_wallet_note: Plans are paid from your HOMATCH credit balance (10 credits = $1).
emp_auto_renew_note: Off by default. When on, the next month is paid from your credits on the renewal date. If your balance is too low, nothing is charged and the plan ends.
emp_overage_note: Off by default. When on, emails beyond your plan cost ${{price}} per 1,000, charged from your credits before they are sent.
emp_overage_cap_hint: Each block is 1,000 emails. Leave empty for no cap.
emp_overage_consent: I agree to pay for extra emails beyond my plan at the price above.
emp_update_failed: The change could not be saved.
emp_confirm_body: ${{price}} (incl. VAT) = {{credits}} credits will be taken from your balance now. You get {{emails}} emails for this billing cycle.
emp_already_recorded: This purchase was already recorded. You were not charged twice.
emp_purchase_failed: The purchase could not be completed. Nothing was charged.
emp_err_insufficient: Not enough credits. Top up and try again.
emp_err_already_active: This plan is already active for more than 3 days.
emp_err_unavailable: Plans are not available right now.
emd_subtitle: Send emails from your own business domain. HOMATCH shows the DNS records to add; the domain is ready only when the email provider has verified them.
emd_subdomain_tip: Tip: use a subdomain such as mail.yourcompany.com so your existing email is not affected.
emd_added: Domain added. Add the DNS records below, then verify.
emd_default_sender_note: Until a domain is verified, emails are sent from HOMATCH's verified address.
emd_records_note: Add these records at your DNS provider. Changes can take up to a few hours to appear.
emd_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
emd_mx_warning: Only add the records shown here. Do not change or remove the MX records of your existing mailbox.
emd_disconnect_body: Emails will no longer be sent from this domain. Your DNS records are not changed; you can remove them yourself.
emd_action_failed: The action could not be completed.
emd_err_invalid: Enter a valid domain such as mail.company.com.
emd_err_in_use: This domain is already connected to another account.
emd_err_already: You have already added this domain.
emd_err_capacity: No more domains can be added right now. Please contact support.
admin_emx_intro: Revenue, VAT and allocations are separate from recorded provider cost. Scenario rows are estimates from published prices.
admin_emx_load_failed: Email operations could not be loaded.
admin_emx_usage_failed: Provider usage could not be refreshed:
admin_emx_key_dedicated: Marketing email uses its own key ({{env}}).
admin_emx_key_fallback: No dedicated marketing key found; using {{env}}. Set email_marketing_resend_key_env to the key's environment variable name.
admin_emx_no_usage: No usage snapshot yet. Refresh provider usage.
admin_emx_overcommitted: Customer allowances in active cycles ({{committed}}) exceed the provider's monthly email limit ({{limit}}). Do not enable bulk sending until capacity is raised.
admin_emx_margin: Net revenue minus recorded provider cost: {{margin}} (other execution costs not included).
admin_emx_estimate_note: Net / VAT / HOMATCH / execution: Pro {{pro}}; Scale {{scale}}. Transactional rows use the $0.90 per 1,000 marginal rate; broadcast rows use the contact-based Marketing tiers.
emc_explainer: HOMATCH sends marketing email only to contacts with recorded consent. Being found by Find Buyers or imported is not consent.
emc_dialog_body: Record only consent this person actually gave you. A contact found by Find Buyers, or imported without an opt-in, has not consented.
emc_attest: I confirm I hold this person's consent or another lawful basis, and can show it on request.
emc_withdrawn_toast: Consent withdrawn. No more marketing email will go to this contact.
emc_err_opted_out: This person opted out or is suppressed. Only they can opt in again.
emc_err_no_email: This contact has no email address.
emc_err_failed: Could not save the consent change.
